scripts.speaker: Keiki
scripts.text:
Hello there, adventurer.
I've been studying magic from all over Rune-Midgarts to upgrade what I believe to be one of the greatest skills available to the acolyte class.

scripts.speaker: Keiki
scripts.text: I am the one and only Acolyte that has attained the Level 10 Warp Portal skill!

scripts.speaker: Keiki
scripts.text:
That's right! And...
I promise you that I don't forget locations that I have already memorized.
One day I will level up my skills to warp to wherever I please~

scripts.speaker: Keiki
scripts.text:
I am willing to warp you to the many locations that I have memorized for a small fee.
Would you like to use this service?

scripts.speaker: Keiki
scripts.text:
Where would you like to go to?
I wish you goodluck on your journey.

scripts.speaker: Keiki
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.

scripts.speaker: Isalei
scripts.text:
Hello, adventurer.
My companion Keiki and I have discovered a way to increase our warp portal abilities.

scripts.speaker: Isalei
scripts.text: Though I have not mastered up to the level that she has, I have been able to attain Level 5.

scripts.speaker: Isalei
scripts.text: Maybe one day I can level up my skills enough so that I can use Warp portal to more saved locations.
